C:P1.1.text: NVR, Inc is the parent company of Ryan Homes, NVHomes, and Heartland Homes and is one of the nation's leading homebuilders

C:P1.2.text: NVR, Inc. operates in two business segments: homebuilding and mortgage banking. The homebuilding unit sells and constructs homes under the Ryan Homes, and NVHomes trade names.

C:P1.3.text: Over 600,000 homeowners have trusted NVR, Inc. for their families and their future.

C:P1.4.text: NVR, Inc. operates in two business segments: homebuilding and mortgage banking. The homebuilding unit sells and constructs homes under the Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes brands. These include sales and marketing support, vital human resource specialists, and an advanced information technology department, which provide a network of resources utilized by NVR, Inc. holdings.

Building Products supplies structural building components, produced to exacting standards in a controlled environment and then delivered to the job site, to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
